title: Rav Huna bar Sechorah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: A great man in Rava’s time, as in Bekhorot 60a: Rav Huna bar Sechorah interpreted it before Rava at the pre-festival lecture; Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said: “Fortunate is his mother” (his mother merited a son like him — Rashi), “who answered it at the pre-festival lecture.” In Chullin 107a Rav Huna bar Sechorah was standing before Rav Hamnuna (IV); Rav Huna cut a piece of meat for Rav Hamnuna and said to him, “Were it not that you are Rav Hamnuna, I would not feed you,” etc.

notes.text: בריגלא concerns a public lecture, not a leg. Saved Rashi on Bekhorot 60a specifies the Sabbath before the festival when festival laws were expounded. Saved Rashi on Chullin 107b first explains בלם as cutting a piece of meat, then offers a roasting/embedding alternative, not squeezing it. The feeding address retains “you are Rav Hamnuna.” The supplied Chullin 107a is retained alongside saved Davidson 107b. The marker ד) is understood as Hyman’s numbered Hamnuna entry, not a new genealogy claim.
